# dsh-deepseek-balance
**DeepSeek Platform balance in the DeepSeek Harness composer.** Every currency the account holds liv
es in one compact pill in the composer tool row, inside the shared centered pill group; click it for
a DSH-style details dialog with the topped-up, granted and total balance per currency, the combined
total and the official Usage and Top up links.
Zero configuration. The plugin reads the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential DSH already stores — or the s
igned-in DeepSeek account when no key exists. No cookie, no scraping, no settings page.
**Español** → README.es.md
**Project page** → jmolo.es/proyectos/dsh-deepseek-balance
*The details window: one block per currency with its topped-up, granted and total balance, the combi
ned total, last update, auto-refresh cadence, data source and the official Usage and Top up links. T
he chat background is blurred for privacy.*
*The compact pill: the DeepSeek mark and the balance of every currency with a balance, separated by
`·`. It joins the shared centered pill group used by the other JaMoLpE88 plugins and is visible only
with a DeepSeek model; with several pills visible they sit side by side, centered, with a small gap
ith a DeepSeek model; with several pills visible they sit side by side, centered, with a small gap.*
## What it does
- Shows the balance of every currency the account holds in one compact pill: `[logo] $8.23 🎁 ¥120.00

`.
- Marks the granted part with a gift icon; the topped-up part stays plain. A currency with no bal

ance is not shown at all.
- Opens a native-looking details dialog on click: **topped-up**, **granted

** and **total** per currency — zeros included, because the dialog is where the detail belongs.
- Ad
ds the combined total in the same dialog: `$8.23 + ¥120.00`, because currencies never add up. With n
othing left it reads **No balance** in red, and it turns red too when the API reports that the balan

ce no longer covers calls.
- Links straight to the official Platform pages: **Usage** and **Top up**

.
- Refreshes the balance every 60 seconds and when the app window becomes visible again.
- Appears
only while the active model belongs to a DeepSeek provider (`deepseek-official` or `deepseek-account

`). Other providers show nothing.
- Appears on a new, empty Session before its first prompt, followi

ng the provider the composer's model control displays.
- Joins the centered pill group shared with t
he other JaMoLpE88 composer plugins: with several pills visible they sit side by side, centered, wit
h a small gap, and hide together when the row is too narrow.
## What it does not do

- It does not read Platform cookies or scrape the usage page.
- It does not ask for a key or store o

ne in the plugin.
- It does not show an expiry countdown: no reachable DeepSeek endpoint exposes the

granted balance's expiry date.
- It does not keep balance history, charts, telemetry or local stora

ge.
- It does not add tools, commands or changes to the agent.
- It does not show anything when the
active model is not from DeepSeek.
## Why there are no settings
If a DeepSeek model is selected, the provider is configured and its credential is already available
to DSH. The plugin resolves that credential on the Host side and reads the official balance API. Wit
hout a key it uses the DeepSeek account signed in to the harness. If no DeepSeek model is selected,
the plugin has nothing useful to show and renders nothing.
There is no plugin config file, no key input, no threshold editor and no refresh preference. It is w
hat it is: the balance the account already knows about.
## Requirements

- **DSH Desktop** `>= 0.2.1-rc.3`, profile `desktop` (tested on `0.2.1-rc.3`, Windows 11).
- A **Dee
pSeek** provider configured in **Settings → Models** (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`), or a DeepSeek account sig

ned in to the harness.
- Node 22+ (DSH ships its own runtime).
If neither exists you cannot select a DeepSeek model, so the plugin never appears. That is intention
neither exists you cannot select a DeepSeek model, so the plugin never appears. That is intentional.

Without a key, the Host half reads the signed-in account instead (`deepseekAccount.getBalance`), whi
ch returns the topped-up and granted wallets per currency; the plugin normalizes both sources to the
same shape, so the interface never changes.
- The key is resolved from DSH's credential service (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`) on each read; `DEEPSEEK_API

_KEY` in the process environment is the fallback.
- Results are cached for 55 seconds so the 60-seco

nd poll and multiple windows share one upstream request.
- Upstream failures keep the last known bal

ances and mark them **stale** instead of blanking the pill.

## Compatibility

| DSH | `>= 0.2.1-rc.3` (the only version tested by the author) |
| Node | `>= 22` |
| OS | Windows

11 (tested); macOS and Linux untested |
| Profile | `desktop` |
| Provider | DeepSeek configured in

**Settings → Models**, or a DeepSeek account signed in |
| Pill group | Shared with the other JaMoLp

E88 composer pills (centered, side by side) |
| Catalog | listed on dsh-plugin.org |
| Project page
| jmolo.es/proyectos/dsh-deepseek-balance |
Validation status: **tested on Windows 11 with DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3** (2026-10-27). The pill appea
rs only with a DeepSeek model, the details dialog opens, the per-currency breakdown and the combined
total follow the live API, the provider gate hides the pill for other models, and manual refresh wo
al follow the live API, the provider gate hides the pill for other models, and manual refresh works.
Not validated: macOS, Linux, other DSH versions, and the web profile.
## Privacy

- No cookies, no browser session scraping.
- The API key never leaves the Host process: the browser

receives only amounts and currency codes.
- No configuration file, no local storage, no telemetry, n

o third-party requests beyond the official balance endpoint and the Platform links you click.
- The
Host does not log the key or include it in error messages.
